llm.summary: This chemistry lesson planner uses clearly scoped classroom information and requires teacher approval before saving lesson plans.

dimensions.detail: Reads classroom performance summaries and pseudonymous student tiers for lesson differentiation; prohibits real names, contact details, and health or family information.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown and a JSON schema, with declared related-skill dependencies and no executable installer or remote payload.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Explicitly limits reads to relevant teaching fields and writes to confirmed lesson plans. An unbundled security-baseline citation is supplemented by explicit privacy rules.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Discloses platform-backed memory, teacher-confirmed saves, and controls for viewing, correction, deletion, pausing, export, and sharing. No privileged access or background execution is requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Lesson planning, curriculum references, and classroom differentiation fit the stated purpose; experiment content requires teacher review.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use anonymized classroom information and review your platform’s memory and sharing settings. Approve saved plans deliberately, and have a qualified teacher check generated questions and laboratory safety before classroom use. Related skills require separate review.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The advisory incomplete-analysis concern does not establish evasion: shared/vocab.md is bundled and was reviewed, including its copyright and consent definitions.
[AE4] expected: Across all three flagged files, the mixed characters are ordinary Chinese prose, technical identifiers, and mathematical or chemical notation. Inspection found no hidden control characters or concealed instructions.
